root.label: Alex Jones shares misleading claim about Moscow passenger screening

events.label: Alex Jones shares misleading claim about Moscow passenger screening

slots.name: mandatory temperature checks
slots.sentence: US conspiracy theorist Alex Jones, for example, shared a post claiming that Russia had introduced mandatory temperature checks for passengers arriving in Moscow from Irkursk.

slots.name: post views
slots.sentence: The post received more than one million views.

slots.name: flight origin
slots.sentence: But the flight shown in the post was not arriving from Irkursk, but from Thailand.

slots.name: footage post date
slots.sentence: Flight information we verified from the video shows it was a Bangkok-to-Moscow service, and the footage was posted online on October 4.
